persons_found.description: Number of persons matched by the provided IDs or distinct IDs.

persons_deleted.description: Number of person records deleted from the database. 0 if keep_person was true.

events_queued_for_deletion.description: Whether event deletion was requested for the matched persons. If a deletion was already queued for a person, it will not be duplicated.

recordings_queued_for_deletion.description: Whether recording deletion was requested for the matched persons. If a deletion was already queued for a person, it will not be duplicated.

deletion_errors.description: Persons that could not be deleted. Each entry contains 'person_uuid'. Contact support if this persists.
